Description._jp: 強さを追い求めるため 国を捨て 放浪者となった。 放浪を始めたものの 方向音痴のせいで なかなか 目的地にたどり着けない。
Description._en: In pursuit of strength, he abandoned his country and became a wanderer. Although he started wandering, he had a hard time reaching his destination due to his lack of sense of direction.
Description._fr: En quête de force, il abandonna son pays et devint un vagabond. Bien qu’il ait commencé à errer, il a eu du mal à atteindre sa destination en raison de son manque de sens de l’orientation.
